verdicts.decision_note: The client authorizes the financial-model build using the twelve-site structure and requires unavailable site-level data to be modeled from corridor information and documented assumptions; the delivery deadline is not encoded.
The freelancer identifies materially different twelve-site lists in the two source documents, requiring a client decision before the model's site structure can be finalized.
The client selects the Business Case site list as the authoritative site structure for the base-case financial model; no existing model attribute becomes stale or requires removal.
The client's authoritative site-list decision resolves the material value conflict and permits work on the twelve-site model structure to continue.
